name: @veren/sub2api-admin-bundle
description: Use when a DSH profile should carry the whole Sub2API operations stack (model-facing admin tools and their metadata) installed and composed in one step: it is a configuration-only bundle whose patch inserts the tool plugin row, while the member plugin ships as a plain dependency without a bundle declaration of its own; skip it when you want to compose the tool row row-by-row in your own patch.
